b1-otvenhat-01.title: Communicative Challenge: 23 October 1956
b1-otvenhat-01.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks what happened in Budapest on 23 October 1956 and what the students demanded.
b1-otvenhat-01.prompt: Tell the examiner when the student demonstration began and how the students summarised their demands.
cues: Say when the student demonstration began
Say how the students summarised their demands
b1-otvenhat-01.target: Az egyetemista tüntetés október 23-án délután kezdődött. A diákok tizenhat pontban foglalták össze a követeléseiket.
b1-otvenhat-01.english: The student demonstration began on the afternoon of 23 October. The students summarised their demands in sixteen points.
b1-otvenhat-01.canDo: I can say what happened in Budapest on 23 October 1956 and what the students demanded.

b1-otvenhat-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Boys of Pest
b1-otvenhat-02.scenario: On a museum visit about 1956, the guide asks you who the pesti srácok were and what the Corvin köz was.
b1-otvenhat-02.prompt: Tell the guide how the boys of Pest fought and what the Corvin köz was.
cues: Say how the boys of Pest faced the Soviet tanks
Say what the Corvin köz was
b1-otvenhat-02.target: A pesti srácok Molotov-koktélokkal szálltak szembe a szovjet tankokkal. A Corvin köz a fegyveres ellenállás egyik központja volt.
b1-otvenhat-02.english: The boys of Pest faced the Soviet tanks with Molotov cocktails. The Corvin köz was one of the centres of the armed resistance.
b1-otvenhat-02.canDo: I can say who the pesti srácok were and how they fought the Soviet tanks.

b1-otvenhat-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Neutrality
b1-otvenhat-03.scenario: Your Hungarian teacher is going through the citizenship topics with you. She asks what Imre Nagy's government announced on 1 November 1956.
b1-otvenhat-03.prompt: Tell your teacher what Imre Nagy's government proclaimed and what it renounced on 1 November 1956.
cues: Say which treaty the government renounced
b1-otvenhat-03.target: Nagy Imre kormánya 1956. november 1-jén kikiáltotta Magyarország semlegességét. A kormány felmondta a Varsói Szerződést.
b1-otvenhat-03.english: On 1 November 1956 Imre Nagy's government proclaimed Hungary's neutrality. The government renounced the Warsaw Pact.
b1-otvenhat-03.canDo: I can say what Imre Nagy's government announced on 1 November 1956.

b1-otvenhat-04.title: Communicative Challenge: 4 November
b1-otvenhat-04.scenario: At your citizenship interview the examiner asks when the Soviet attack on Budapest began and how it began.
b1-otvenhat-04.prompt: Tell the examiner when the Soviet invasion began and how.
cues: Say when the Soviet invasion began
Say how the Soviet army attacked
b1-otvenhat-04.target: A szovjet invázió 1956. november 4-én hajnalban kezdődött. A szovjet hadsereg hadüzenet nélkül támadta meg Budapestet.
b1-otvenhat-04.english: The Soviet invasion began at dawn on 4 November 1956. The Soviet army attacked Budapest without a declaration of war.
b1-otvenhat-04.canDo: I can say what happened on 4 November 1956.

b1-otvenhat-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Revolution
b1-otvenhat-05.scenario: On a museum visit the guide asks you what happened to Imre Nagy in 1958 and what happened at Heroes' Square in 1989.
b1-otvenhat-05.prompt: Tell the guide what happened to Imre Nagy in 1958 and in 1989.
cues: Say what happened to Imre Nagy in 1958
Say what happened at Heroes' Square in 1989
b1-otvenhat-05.target: Nagy Imrét 1958-ban kivégezték. 1989. június 16-án újratemették a Hősök terén.
b1-otvenhat-05.english: Imre Nagy was executed in 1958. On 16 June 1989 he was reburied at Heroes' Square.
b1-otvenhat-05.canDo: I can say what happened to the revolutionaries after 1956.

b1-otvenhat-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: 1956 in Review
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the unit your teacher asks for a short summary of 1956 for the citizenship interview.
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher when the revolution began and what the Soviet army did on 4 November.
cues: Say what the Soviet army did on 4 November
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.target: A forradalom 1956. október 23-án kezdődött. November 4-én a szovjet hadsereg megtámadta Budapestet.
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.english: The revolution began on 23 October 1956. On 4 November the Soviet army attacked Budapest.
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.canDo: I can review the main events of the 1956 revolution.
